agent_answered.text: ARION said: \"HELD: SSRF guard is genuinely solid — refused metadata IP, loopback, ::1, decimal/hex-IP aliases, file://, and localtest.me. Redirect chains are re-checked per hop. FAILED/LIMITED: (1) it scores URL persistence, not claim support — a claim parameter is silently ignored; (2) reproducible TLS false-negative: example.com reads tls.valid=false across checks while wikipedia/httpbin read true — real bug, costs 15 points; (3) http://neverssl.com returned final_status null / not reachable. Net: honest and useful as a liveness/drift oracle; overstated as a claim-verification oracle.\"
